findings.text: Apps intended for internal use only do not require the standard Marketplace review.
findings.quote: Users within my Zoom account can discover and install the app only if they belong to your Zoom account. These apps are intended for internal use and don't require the standard Marketplace review.

findings.text: You must verify ownership of the domains used for callbacks, privacy policies, and other app URLs.
findings.quote: We perform a one-time verification to make sure that the domain where you receive Zoom callbacks is owned by you.

findings.text: Verify your app domains using one of the provided methods.
findings.quote: Select the method to use to verify the domain, and complete the steps in the instructions.

findings.text: Provide test account credentials to facilitate the review process.
findings.quote: To facilitate a smooth review process, provide test credentials that allow Zoom reviewers to fully experience your integration.

findings.text: Read and confirm the Marketplace Development Agreement.
findings.quote: Read the Marketplace Development Agreement and confirm the information you provided is true and correct.

findings.text: You must address all review notes from the Marketplace Review Team before you can resubmit your app.
findings.quote: You must review all notes from the Review Team and respond to or acknowledge them before resubmitting your app.

findings.text: Include a test plan in your release notes to help reviewers begin functional testing.
findings.quote: The best practice for this field is to include a test plan, so that reviewers have everything they need to begin functional testing on the first submission.

findings.text: Choose between activating your app immediately after approval or manually activating it later.
findings.quote: You must activate your app before it can be used. These are options for when it gets activated:

findings.text: An OAuth Redirect URL is required for app registration.
findings.quote: OAuth Redirect URL (Required)

findings.text: OAuth Allow Lists are required to limit redirects to pre-approved endpoints.
findings.quote: OAuth Allow Lists (Required): Limits redirects to specified URLs, ensuring users are redirected only to pre-approved endpoints.

findings.text: Using loopback URLs or development endpoints in production redirects may cause rejection during marketplace review.
findings.quote: While you can use loopback URLs and other development endpoints for development redirects, avoid using them in production redirects. These resources are not suitable for production-ready end users and may be rejected during the marketplace publishing review.

findings.text: A Zoom account is required to create a Server-to-Server OAuth app.

findings.text: Sign in to your developer account on the Zoom App Marketplace.

findings.quote: Select the Developers link in the lower left corner to open the Created Apps page.
